compatibility_static_review.original_operation: fetch_update(AcqRel, Acquire), checked addition and fixed-limit filter
compatibility_static_review.replacement_operation: Acquire load; checked addition and fixed-limit filter; compare_exchange_weak(AcqRel, Acquire); retry with observed current value
acceptance_reasons: The upper bound and checked addition are evaluated before the atomic commit; limit rejection and u64 overflow leave the counter unchanged.
Successful compare-exchange is the reservation linearization point, preserving indivisible all-or-nothing byte reservations under contention.
Both competing-writer failure and permitted weak compare-exchange failure retry using the returned current value; no stale desired value or unchecked retry is used.
Successful AcqRel and unsuccessful Acquire orderings are preserved, including an initial Acquire load; zero-byte reservations and existing error text remain consistent.
Existing event/JSON writing, prefix-retention behavior, driver bounds, binary binding, cancellation and all pre-existing tests are unchanged.
No MSRV declaration, warning suppression, CI gate, Cargo dependency, source registry, legacy test or full oracle is changed by this source commit.

new_tests_inspected.name: concurrent_reservations_fill_only_whole_reservations_within_the_budget
new_tests_inspected.case: 16 barrier-started threads each attempt 2,000 reservations of 7 bytes with a 10,007-byte limit. Requires exactly 1,429 successful reservations, 10,003 charged bytes, and a further rejection that preserves the counter.

new_tests_inspected.name: rejected_reservations_preserve_the_counter_at_limit_and_overflow_boundaries
new_tests_inspected.case: Rejects a reservation crossing 63/64, permits the exact limit, preserves the counter on later rejection and zero-byte requests; then tests exact u64::MAX and addition overflow without wrapping.
